gen-gf-calligraffitti-satoshi: Friendly marker-traced letters tower over the line in Calligraffitti, loose and a bit wild. Satoshi settles beneath them with a soaring x-height and strokes cut to one width, which is where the pair really works.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-switzer: Graceful, marker-drawn Calligraffitti stretches its tall midzone and lets its counters spill into the space around it. Switzer, a plain sans of wire-like tubular letters, does the opposite job, holding its c tips apart and keeping things tidy.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-work-sans: Calligraffitti arrives with a hand-traced, marker-made look, its towering midzone leaning friendly and graceful. Work Sans follows with a high mean line and c tips that never close in, which feels thoroughly modern beside it.
gen-gf-caprasimo-fs-rowan: Rowan, a text serif with generous openings in every curve, reads friendly and literary, its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. Caprasimo up top is the tight, cramped one, so the body feels like a window opening.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-fs-gambetta: Gambetta is bookish and graceful, with wide channels leading into every counter. Castoro Titling above it swings between heavy shoulders and hairline joins, while Gambetta's modulation stays mellow, so the heading can be set noticeably larger without crowding it.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-fs-rowan: Rowan reads literary and friendly, with generous curve openings and a mild, pen-like shift between thick and thin. Castoro Titling gives the pair its edge, because its stark, wire-thin joins against heavy columns make the body feel gentler.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-lora: Hairline joins like pulled wire sit against heavy columns in Castoro Titling, which makes it commanding and expressive. Lora, a text serif with sturdy thin lines and a broad, welcoming c, takes over where that drama would tire.
gen-gf-cause-fs-neco: Friendly and inviting, Cause draws a wide-open e and diagonals that match its stems, like a line of wire gliding under the eye. And Neco, a classic serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, gives paragraphs a dignified, unpinched feel.
gen-gf-cause-fs-recia: Recia looks sharp and authoritative, its light modulation showing mainly up close. Cause draws every stroke at a single thickness, and that hand-drawn looseness against Recia's slightly lighter thin strokes is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-cause-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, with monoline strokes and curve endings kept well apart from each other. Cause is the loose one, a friendly hand-drawn heading, and that looseness is the pair's best quality.
